title: Make a pizza
intro: In this short study you will make a virtual pizza by dragging toppings onto it, and then answer a few questions about it and about yourself. Nothing is eaten.
It takes about 10 minutes and needs a desktop or laptop computer with a mouse or trackpad. Your answers are stored without your name.
consent: I have read the information above and agree to take part.

pilot-asd.description: Pilot: autistic adults (ASD), recruited through community organisations
intro: In this short study you will make a virtual pizza by dragging toppings onto it, and then answer a few questions about it and about yourself. Nothing is eaten.
It is part of a pilot study on how autistic people choose food. It takes about 10 minutes and needs a desktop or laptop computer with a mouse or trackpad. Your answers are stored without your name.
